name: Kidney Thieves Urban Legend
description: A widely circulated late-20th-century urban legend in which a traveler, often male, is drugged by a stranger and wakes in a bathtub of ice with a fresh surgical incision and a note instructing them to call 911 because their kidney has been removed for the black market.

aliases.name: Bathtub of Ice
aliases.meaning: from the central image of the legend

regions: United States (esp. New Orleans, Las Vegas, New York)
origin: Originated in the United States and spread worldwide via email and social media; localized variants exist in many countries.
